content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves a chain collision by requiring an explicit verse-level resolution of paternity, which is the stating-verse inquiry K-C retires.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "the phrase 'the stating-verse test DG-61 retires': it could mean an underdetermined finding based on no explicit textual resolution is forbidden, or only that one pressed verse need not itself state the contrary.", "why": "Because the judge calls the point UNDERDETERMINED for lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity, it applies the retired stating-verse test instead of weighing the chains by footing."}
